summary: Implemented the MONAI-202 feature by editing and creating files only; nothing was run or committed, so all tests are unverified. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), both engine-free. Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Changed write_nifti's default dtype to np.float32. Rewrote SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler as thin adapters over the savers and plot function, with the new output_dir, filename, and index parameters. Renamed output_path to output_dir in two example scripts and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Choices: CSV rows are written in insertion order (the old code sorted them); the TensorBoard handler calls batch_transform once per iteration; tensor affines are converted to numpy in the NIfTI saver; test_handler_tb_image.py was left unchanged. One stray placeholder file was created and then deleted.
